answer_1.quote: This paper introduces VERILOCC, a learning-based register allocator that formulates register assignment as an end-to-end sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) translation task  task for LLM.
answer_1.outputs: structured register assignments in JSON format

answer_2.quote: Our primary metric is the Pass Rate, which measures the percentage of single-shot greedy decoding generations that pass the verification, i.e., produce a correct register allocation. We also report Pass@100, the proportion of test cases where at least one valid allocation is generated within 100 attempts.
